resources.name: DFT code with GGA+U capability and Dudarev method support (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, GPAW)

access.notes: Agent may use any DFT implementation that supports the PBE functional, Hubbard U correction on La 4f orbitals with the Dudarev method, and produces total energies. The original paper used VASP; open‑source alternatives are acceptable.

resources.name: Bulk LaAlO3 rhombohedral R‑3c crystal structure

access.notes: The structure is a standard 10‑atom rhombohedral cell with the a⁻a⁻a⁻ octahedral tilt pattern. Lattice parameters can be obtained from the literature (a ≈ 3.79 Å, α ≈ 60°) or from a structural database.
